web.title_en: Chrome Builds a Mirror Universe for Agents: Testing Browser Proxies Without Touching the Real Network | CN-SEC
web.description_en: This article reveals the 'Mirror Dimension' synthetic network constructed by the Chrome Security Team. By leveraging dynamic certificate forgery and multi-agent collaboration generation, it successfully addresses the evaluation challenges of browser agents in real networks, such as non-reproducibility, uncontrollability, and exposure of testing intentions. This solution not only enables high-fidelity automated red team exercises but also critically overcomes the model's 'evaluation awareness' trap, setting a new engineering benchmark for the secure iteration of AI agents.

web.title: VirtualBox Process Hardening on Windows 2026 Edition: What's a Single Bit Between Friends?
web.description: Back in 2017 I did some research into Oracle VirtualBox on Windows. Specifically I focussed on their mechanism to protect their VM processes from the user on the host. The protection was to gate who could open the kernel driver, which might allow for privilege escalation due to the way it was designed. At the time I found 3 ways of bypassing the protection, with an additional issue in COM’s runtime I reported in 2020. These issues were all written up in this post.

web.description_en:
Windows DLL Load Anomaly Detection (Part 1): Was the check really performed after the DLL was queued?
The startup enumeration sent plugins into the verification queue. When worker threads retrieved them, they skipped them directly because 'this path has already been registered.' Looking down AntiHijackDlls.cpp, the problem lies in the usage of the same set in two places. Enumeration uses it to record seen paths, while worker threads use it to decide whether further checks are needed.

web.title: AI-Assisted Cyber Attacks Trigger Unauthorized Payments at Indian Banks and Fintech Firms
web.description: The Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) has warned that threat actors are carrying out artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted cyber attacks targeting information and communication technology (ICT) assets in the country.   This unsanctioned activity has resulted in unauthorized financial transactions at banking and financial services entities, as well as technology service providers supporting government-linked payments and platforms handling vendor or partner payouts.
